title: Add exportBackupJson to DailyListViewModel
description: Builds a DataBackupPayload from a snapshot of every profile, medication, and dose log, serializes it, and hands the JSON string back to the caller (the Settings screen writes it to a user-picked file via Storage Access Framework -- this method has no file I/O of its own).
acceptance_criteria: fun exportBackupJson(onResult: (String) -> Unit) is a member of DailyListViewModel

It launches a viewModelScope coroutine that builds a DataBackupPayload from profileRepository.getActiveSnapshot(), medicationRepository.getActiveSnapshot(), and doseLogRepository.getAllSnapshot(), mapping each list's items via their toBackupItem() extension
